where.zh: 探索時（村莊、溪邊、哥布林營地、廢墟祠堂），戰鬥以外都是這首
where.en: While exploring (the village, the stream, the goblin camp, the ruined shrine): everywhere outside battle

harness.notes: initAudio() both creates the context and starts the (single, adaptive) score, so it is called in play after musicMode() picks the mode; init only silences the cricket chirps. The score is 4 pad chords + arpeggio: explore bars are 4.8 s, combat bars 2.4 s, timed by setTimeout. initAudio() also starts a wind-noise ambience bed (lowpassed noise, gain 0.07 x 0.5) that cannot be switched off without editing the game, so it will be faintly under both renders.

notes: One adaptive score with two modes (musicMode('explore'|'combat')), not separate songs. No music files in the repo.
